title: Form 1099-OID box 1 statement items, tax year 2025
closure_claim: Every Original Issue Discount (OID) amount reported in box 1 of a Form 1099-OID furnished to the taxpayer for tax year 2025 is recorded as a statement item. This claim covers Form 1099-OID box 1 only: it says nothing about other 1099-OID boxes, interest not reported on Form 1099-OID, or total taxable interest (Form 1040 line 2b).
